metadata.description: Wet asphalt/concrete texture with water droplets and dramatic lighting
metadata.visual_content: Rough granular dark surface (wet asphalt/concrete/coarse stone) with uneven fragmented particles and subtle cracks. Glistening water droplets scattered across surface creating glossy reflective effect. Deep charcoal/midnight blue base with silvery-white highlights from droplets. Selective lighting from above creates sparkling effect. Sharp foreground with soft bokeh background
metadata.context: Background texture for 'Impacto' theme, creates moody atmospheric quality with urban/industrial feel, dramatic light contrasts
